title: Warm Garlicky Syrian Plum Tomatoes Pilaf
description: A flavorful and energizing Syrian dish featuring plum tomatoes and lardons, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly recipe is served on a traditional talavera plate.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the lardons and cook until crispy, then set aside.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the plum tomatoes, salt, black pepper, paprika, and sumac, and cook for 5 minutes until the tomatoes start to break down.
Add the uncooked basmati rice and cook for 2 minutes until the rice is coated in the tomato mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the crispy lardons and chopped parsley.
Serve the pilaf hot on a traditional talavera plate.
